summary: Frontend-only verification of role-based UI hiding, AdminRoute redirects, and self-service /account. All critical flows work as designed EXCEPT RolesPage was crashing (ErrorBoundary) due to a missing useAuth import — fixed by me. After the fix, admin sees Add/row actions on /users, /roles, /offices; sidebar shows Branding/Broadcast/Database/Clients. Staff (non-admin) sees NO Add/row-actions/bulk-delete on /users, /roles, /offices; sidebar hides admin-only items (verified visually via screenshot); manual navigation to /branding /broadcast /database /clients redirects to /. /account renders profile + password status + change-password form for both users. Staff mismatch validation shows 'Passwords do not match'. Staff self-service password change (staff123 -> staff456) succeeded with success toast, form reset, and no forced logout. NOTE: Staff password is now 'staff456' (changed from 'staff123' during test).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext'` — RolesPage crashed with ReferenceError: useAuth is not defined for both admin and staff (caught by ErrorBoundary). Fixed by testing agent by adding the import at line 39.

The `roles-actions-btn` dropdown trigger is still rendered for non-admins because its `Structure` menu item is not admin-gated. Admin-only items (Add role, Import, Levels) inside the menu are correctly hidden via {isAdmin && ...}. Review request expected NO roles-actions-btn for non-admin. Either gate the whole button when only Structure remains, or move Structure to its own button, or accept the current behavior as read-only Structure viewer.
Row-selection checkboxes column is still rendered for non-admins even though the only selection-driven action (bulk-delete) is admin-only. Minor UX noise; not a security issue.

action_items: Review RolesPage.jsx import list — ensure other page files (Users, Offices) also correctly import useAuth to avoid regressions (Users and Offices verified working during this run).
Decide whether to hide the entire `roles-actions-btn` when the only remaining item is `Structure`, to match the spec's 'no mutation button visible' expectation strictly.
Optionally hide the row-selection checkbox column on RolesPage for non-admin users.
critical_code_review_comments: RolesPage.jsx had `const { isAdmin } = useAuth();` at line 682 but no matching import — build-time not caught because it fails at runtime. Consider adding a lightweight ESLint rule (`no-undef`) run in CI to catch these.
RolesPage.jsx is 1358 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into smaller components (RoleTable, RoleTree, LevelsDialog, StructureDialog, BulkDeleteDialog).

success_rate.frontend: 95% after fix (100% for admin/staff role-hiding on Users & Offices, AdminRoute redirect, /account CRUD; minor: roles-actions-btn still visible to non-admin due to non-gated Structure item)

rca of the issue: RolesPage.jsx used `useAuth()` (line 682) without importing it. Missing `import { useAuth } from '@/context/AuthContext';` at the top of the file caused a runtime ReferenceError that ErrorBoundary intercepted. Reproduction: log in as any user and navigate to /roles — page renders as ErrorBoundary fallback. Mitigation applied: added the import line after `import API from '@/lib/api';`.
